name: Code of Hammurabi Stele
description: Basalt stele inscribed with 282 Babylonian laws beneath a relief of Hammurabi receiving authority from the sun-god Shamash. Looted to Susa in antiquity, excavated in 1901, now in the Louvre — the most complete early law code known.

name: Mask of Tutankhamun
description: Eleven-kilogram gold funerary mask inlaid with lapis and glass, found on the pharaoh's mummy in his nearly intact tomb by Howard Carter in 1922 — the emblem of Egyptian archaeology.
